## Checklist

- [ ] `make test-scripts` passes.
- [ ] Rendering, loading screen or settings changes were checked in the CPU-only lab, and the screenshots were inspected.
- [ ] New mixins belong to a `Feature`, appear in `preheat.mixins.json` and delegate decisions to tested plain classes.
- [ ] Player-facing documentation, settings and log examples reflect the change.
